description: This file contains Go source code for managing protobuf file descriptors, enums, message types, and extensions registration within the protobuf runtime, including functions for registering and retrieving descriptors, enums, and message types, with cache management and deprecated API usage.

methods.name: RegisterFile
methods.description: Registers a compressed FileDescriptorProto with a file path, decompressing and building the descriptor, and caching it.

methods.name: FileDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the compressed FileDescriptorProto for a given file path, using cache or registry lookup.

methods.name: RegisterEnum
methods.description: Registers enum value names to numbers for a given enum name, storing in cache.

methods.name: EnumValueMap
methods.description: Returns a map of enum value names to numbers for a given enum name, updating cache if needed.

methods.name: RegisterType
methods.description: Registers a Go message type for a protobuf message name.

methods.name: RegisterMapType
methods.description: Registers a Go map type for a protobuf map entry message name.

methods.name: MessageType
methods.description: Returns the Go reflect.Type for a given protobuf message name, using cache or registry lookup.

methods.name: MessageName
methods.description: Returns the full protobuf name for a given message instance.

methods.name: RegisteredExtensions
methods.description: Returns registered extensions for a protobuf message, updating cache if needed.
